metadata.hardware: Intel Core i7-12700H, 20 logical CPUs, 64 GB RAM
metadata.scope: Private Xvfb, production GTK app and Quickshell widget, synthetic PCM, loopback compatible speech; no physical microphone, live provider or Wayland measurement
metadata.cache_policy: No OS cache drop; fresh private profile followed by normal Quit and same-profile process restart
metadata.ordering: One warmup pair, then six paired trials per mode; baseline first on odd trials, candidate first on even trials
